_note: Morphogen transport parameters FETCHED on 2026-10-31 by the organism thread. Nothing here is from memory. Each entry records what was retrieved, the URL it came from, and whether the value was read in a primary source or quoted at second hand. Values with kind=assumed were NOT found and are placeholders that must not be read as measured.
warning_stage_mismatch: Every measured value below comes from the zebrafish GASTRULA, because that is where FCS and FRAP on morphogens have been done. The first validation target is a PECTORAL FIN BUD at 72 hpf. Carrying a gastrula diffusion coefficient to a fin bud is an assumption, not a measurement, and every result that depends on it inherits that.

parameters.source: NOT FOUND. Searched on 2026-10-31 for FCS or FRAP measurements of Shh transport in zebrafish; none was retrieved. The tool has no measured Shh value and substitutes the Fgf8a fast-fraction coefficient when asked to model a Shh source, labelling it borrowed wherever it does so.
parameters.caution: Any Shh result from this engine rests on a borrowed Fgf8 coefficient. That is the largest unmeasured assumption in the first validation target, because that target is a Hedgehog perturbation.

method_cautions.caution: FRAP diffusion coefficients measured over a large region are one to two orders of magnitude lower than coefficients measured locally, and tissue architecture alone can halve the effective coefficient relative to free diffusion. A single D is therefore not a property of the molecule; it depends on the scale and the method of measurement.
method_cautions.source: Single-molecule tracking of Nodal and Lefty in live zebrafish embryos supports hindered diffusion model, Nature Communications
method_cautions.quote: global morphogen diffusion coefficients (D_glob) measured over a large region (> 100 um) are lower by one to two orders of magnitude compared to their local diffusion coefficient (D_loc)

method_cautions.caution: A pure source-sink picture may be wrong for Fgf8: binding to heparan sulfate proteoglycans hinders diffusion, and a hindered-diffusion model has been proposed instead. The engine implements source-sink only, so it implements the simpler of two live hypotheses.
method_cautions.source: Fine-tuning of Fgf8 morphogen gradient by heparan sulfate proteoglycans in the extracellular matrix, Biophysical Journal
